verify.general: yes: "Recommended Candidates ... Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026" sample ballot with general-election ballot numbers.
verify.note: Read the live page text. All 87 entries (27 candidates + 60 retention) appear as printed. Unlabeled circuit entries 103-107 map one-to-one to the five countywide vacancies (Burke, Cobbs, Coghlan, Hooks, Karkula), each of which has exactly that one candidate in the contests file; Josina Morita = County Commissioner 13th District; Lampkin = the only Appellate retention judge. Retention list: page says "Please vote YES to retain ALL retention judges" and names Lampkin plus 59 circuit judges; all 60 match the 60 retention judges in the contests file. Judith C. Rice is NOT removed from the retention entries: the contests file lists her BOTH as the Hoffman appellate vacancy candidate (Judge of the Appellate Court (Vacancy of Hoffman)) AND as a Circuit Court retention judge (cook-clerk:720001:judith-c-rice, chicago-boe:retention:judith-c-rice), and the page prints her in both lists (102 and 237), so both entries are supported by page and ballot.
